selected_subject_gaps.title: Single-qubit state
observed_source_anchors: Decoherence: the arrow sinks off the surface
selected_subject_gaps.visible_construction: One meridian, one equator and one radial pointer in a compact sphere-like specimen; no nucleus or orbital ellipses.
selected_subject_gaps.differentiation: State representation rather than atom, black hole, terrestrial globe or probability wavepacket.
semantic_caveats: Bloch-sphere-inspired illustration; geometry and pointer are not a computed state or gate.
A surface pointer evokes a pure single-qubit state; mixed states must not be described as constrained to the surface.
Not a physical electron orbit, quantum processor, entanglement diagram or depiction of arbitrary quantum operations.

selected_subject_gaps.title: Cantilever gyroscope
observed_source_anchors: Torque is a rate of change of a vector
selected_subject_gaps.visible_construction: One off-centre rotor disc, one oblique axle and a clearly connected end support.
selected_subject_gaps.differentiation: Supported angular-momentum object rather than the generic Engineering mechanism or control-theory flyball governor.
semantic_caveats: Static object metaphor; does not demonstrate motion, conservation or a measured precession rate.
No claimed dimensions, balance, manufacturability, bearing friction, nutation or dynamics validation.
Do not infer the slow-precession approximation from a picture alone.

selected_subject_gaps.title: Reverse-mode retained computation
observed_source_anchors: One forward pass, one backward pass
selected_subject_gaps.visible_construction: Curled retained computation tape and one stylus revisiting an earlier impression; no node network, conveyor or memory stack.
selected_subject_gaps.differentiation: Reuse of saved intermediate work rather than forward data transport, buffering, storage hierarchy or an optimizer landscape.
semantic_caveats: Tape and stylus are an authored bookkeeping analogy; not a historical or physical autodiff device.
Reverse sensitivity accumulation does not invert, rewind, erase or undo the forward function.
The image does not encode derivatives, local Jacobians, path sums, executable operations or a model architecture.
Backprop computes gradients; parameter updates belong to a separate optimizer step.

selected_subject_gaps.title: Vectorised arithmetic
selected_subject_gaps.visible_construction: One shared four-nib stylus acting across separate strips; the common tool and distinct contact points carry the meaning.
selected_subject_gaps.differentiation: One coordinated operation over several elements rather than transformation through a compiler press, item transport, network fanout or a cell grid.
semantic_caveats: Nib count is compositional; it does not assert SIMD width, thread count, instruction set or hardware lanes.
Array syntax and vectorised APIs do not alone prove a particular SIMD execution mechanism.
No hardware, performance, energy-efficiency, numerical-equivalence or benchmark claim is encoded.
Four nibs are a requested visual construction, not a measured data count.
